title: Bases of a Decision on a ShieldCare Claim
content:
## The peril

A claim on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is approved only when the peril reported is
one the plan covers. The plan's switches for accidental damage, liquid ingress, power surge,
screen breakage, theft, battery health and cosmetic marks decide the peril, and a peril the plan
does not carry is denied as not covered whatever the repair would cost.

## The documents

A claim is adjudicated only once the documents the plan requires are recorded as received
against that claim reference. The record of what has arrived against the claim reference is the
authority; the customer's word that the receipt was emailed is not a substitute, and the
attestation held on the intake record does not stand in for a document that has not arrived.

A theft claim additionally needs a police report on file, and a claim on a plan that requires
proof of purchase needs that proof. Where either is missing the customer is given the plan's
days to supply it, and the claim is denied for want of proof only after that.

## Two denials that turn on the item rather than the paperwork

A fault the item already had before cover started is denied as pre-existing. Use of the item in
a business, on a plan that does not cover commercial use, is denied as not covered.

## The form an approval takes

An approved claim is settled by repair while repairs on the item are still below the plan's
repair attempts figure. Once that figure is reached, or the same fault has been repaired as
often as the no-lemon figure allows, the next approval is settled by replacement instead. The
repairs counted are the decisions recorded as settled by repair on the same covered item serial,
taken across the whole life of that item from its purchase day to the day of handling.

A replacement is settled at what the plan's replacement basis names. A reimbursement is offered
instead only where no equivalent model is stocked.

## Appeal

A denial may be appealed within the plan's appeal window. An appeal is a fresh decision on the
same claim reference, rather than a new claim.

## Points of judgement

| Fact recorded | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| Peril reported is one the plan does not carry | Denied as not covered, whatever the repair would cost |
| Required documents not yet recorded against the reference | Not adjudicated yet; the customer has the plan's days to supply |
| Theft reported, no police report on file after those days | Denied for want of proof |
| Fault present before cover started | Denied as pre-existing |
| Repairs on the item still below the plan's repair attempts figure | Settled by repair |
| Repairs on the item have reached that figure | The next approval is settled by replacement |
| No equivalent model stocked | A reimbursement is offered in place of the replacement |
